title: Disclosure widget
summary: Handle a click, flip a boolean and keep `aria-expanded` in sync.
prompt: Finish `Disclosure`. The button shows `title` and has `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. The panel is `hidden` while closed. Clicking toggles it and calls `onToggle(nextOpen)` if given. `defaultOpen` sets the starting state.
hints: Pass a function: `onClick={() => toggle()}`. Writing `onClick={toggle()}` would call it during render.
Use `useId()` to build an id for `aria-controls`.
